newsitem.title: RUSSIA: RESEARCH ALERT - Russian GUM rated "buy".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Russian GUM rated "buy".

text.p: Salomon Brothers has rated shares in Russia's biggest retailer OAO Torgovy Dom GUM a buy, citing the historic shopping centre's sustained revenues and earnings growth.
GUM is "a leader in a segment with huge potential" and has a strong management team, a Salomon note obtained by Reuters on Tuesday said.
It said GUM, which is situated next to the Kremlin on Red Square, was undervalued on revenues and earnings and that its development plans supported growth.
On the Russian Trading System, a local version of NASDAQ, GUM was traded at $27.0 on March 14, the last day the stock was traded.
GUM's market capitalisation is 940 billion roubles, Salomon said.
